svg.title: 2SFCA two-pass intuition diagram
svg.desc: Left panel shows pass one: each facility looks out at all origins within its catchment and sums weighted demand. Right panel shows pass two: each origin looks at all facilities and sums the facility ratios weighted by decay.
svg.text: How much demand does this facility face?
demand = Σ pop × decay(t) → ratio = 1 / demand
How much supply can this origin reach?
score = Σ ratio × decay(t) across all facilities
Gaussian decay — how weight falls off with travel time
